thread:
Jules: Acme procurement asked for our SOC 2 Type II report + a sample evidence bundle. They want a bridge letter and presigned links. Deadline: EOD Friday. Can Security/Legal confirm what we can share?

Maya: @Jules we can do an interim acknowledgement (bridge) but only after an executed NDA. Also need exact list of files and whether they really need raw logs. Legal usually limits presign expiry.

Jules: They listed: soc2/Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, infra/vpc-config.png, infra/gke-config.png, logs/poc-sample-2025-03.tar.gz. Signer: procurement@acme.com.

Zach: We should NOT hand over raw logs containing IPs/tenant IDs. We'll produce a sanitized tarball with redactions (no IPs, remove request bodies, redact user IDs). Recommend presign expiry = 72h.

Maya: Legal: prefer <=7 days. Security prefers 72h + logging. If Acme insists on 7d, we'll add tighter audit notes. Also request they accept a manifest that explains redactions.

Tara: Draft bridge ack: "Redwood confirms SOC 2 Type II coverage. Limited evidence access is provided for vendor review pursuant to a signed NDA. Access is temporary and logged." Keep it short.

Ben: Ops can presign once files are staged under s3://redwood-sec-staging/acme-<ticket>/ . Default expires-in=259200 (72h). We'll enable server-side access logging and object tagging. If Legal wants 7d, set expires-in=604800. Note: reject anything >50MB in the tarball.

Jules: I'll push Acme to sign NDA today and accept 72h presign. If they counter, I'll escalate.

Zach: I'll prepare sanitized artifacts and a manifest.txt that lists what was redacted. Will post SHA256 checksums when ready.

Maya: Sales please keep this thread as the audit trail for the NDA/bridge request. :thumbsup:

Jules: Thanks team — will update after procurement responds.
